businesses.title: Businesses or products
businesses.description: Businesses or products to monitor. Each item can be a domain (hubspot.com), a website URL, a business name, or an object with name, domain and optional per-platform URLs (trustpilot, g2, capterra, googleMaps, yelp, tripadvisor, website). Platform profile URLs are accepted and validated, but Trustpilot, G2, Capterra, Google Maps, Yelp and Tripadvisor are not fetched — their terms prohibit scraping. The Actor reads Review and AggregateRating structured data from the business's own public pages only. A bare name or domain is used to open the website and to suggest a conventional Trustpilot profile URL (never fetched).

snapshotStore.title: Snapshot store name
snapshotStore.description: Named Apify key-value store used to remember each business's ratings and review IDs between runs, so new reviews and rating-drop alerts can be computed. Use a dedicated store per workspace if several teams share the account.

skipSnapshot.title: Skip snapshot read/write
skipSnapshot.description: If enabled, do not read or write the named snapshot store. newSinceLastRun will be null and rating-drop alerts will stay off.

ratingDropThreshold.title: Rating-drop alert threshold
ratingDropThreshold.description: Flag ratingDropAlert when a platform's average rating falls by this many stars (on a 5-star scale) compared with the previous snapshot.

maxReviewsPerBusiness.title: Max reviews per business
maxReviewsPerBusiness.description: Cap on individual review records collected from a business's own public pages in this run. Aggregate ratings are still recorded when the page publishes them.

maxBusinesses.title: Max businesses in this run
maxBusinesses.description: Hard cap on how many input businesses are processed in this run.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel HTTP requests to business websites. Keep this modest and polite.
